runs.expected: no violation outside the finding witnesses

runs.defect: DX-01 (a same-day day-precision report drops out of the record at the next decision)
DX-02 (a break declared in a weekly review with no pending question is ignored, VALID)
F03 (a machine load logged as prescribed is refused; machine settings fabricated by +1 kg)
F04 (confounded masks an adverse recovery and an impaired next day; the long run advances)
QE-R7C-10 (shortened answer recorded by a clinical route stays unapplied)
R7C-G01 (unknown training planned without a question: unreported weeks read as a stop, entry dose VALID)
D54 (a strength row not done for more than 28 days ignores the race-window dose)
QE-R7D-P3-01(a) (a break declared with another event is asked and then lost: the next plain review is VALID on the pre-break plan)
QE-R7D-P3-01(b) (a break declared with a clinical flag is lost across qualified clearance: the next plain review is VALID on the pre-break plan)
P3-F01 (a break answering UNREPORTED_TRAINING through a clinical route is not retained across clearance: asked again)
SSCTR-P31-F02 (a newer break that names none replaces a kept one: the next review re-enters from the newer break alone; a correction of an applied break ends a kept one, the p4b path)
SSCTR-P31-F02, metamorphic (a newer break stated in the review that applies a kept one re-enters from the newer break alone)
SSCTR-P31-F03 path (a newer nonclinical break replaces a kept clinical-cause break: a nonclinical return)

SSCTR-P32-F01 (training between two separate breaks that completes no whole week of the plan, one run, an aborted run or a week with a session missed, ends the earlier break: the return re-enters from the later break alone)
A named correction of the latest break after a return that read separate breaks drops the earlier break (the direction of SSCTR-P32-F01 through a correction)
PCG-R7D-F08-F01 (a clinical-cause break restated as nonclinical by name re-enters by the nonclinical recipe, with or without a clearance; R-F08-1)
SSCTR-P33-F01 (weeks executed as prescribed in one sport between two separate breaks read as days of the stop: the class grows to a restart)
SSCTR-P34-F01 (a return planned from its own week counts that week's elapsed runs that were not done in the single-run ceiling of the weeks after it)
SSCTR-P34-F05 (a race week with its race touch missed re-enters running: the re-entry predicate omits the race touch and the race, BR-Q4)
A race touch done at half its minutes (partial by the completion rule) re-enters running (SSCTR CFR-05; SSCTR-P34R-F02, BR-Q4.1)
SSCTR-P34R2-F01 (a race week without a gated run re-enters running through converging adverse responses across sports: the systemic rule is not read on the race-key path)
SSCTR-P34R2-F02 (a named correction re-read masks the days of the report it supersedes: a session it uncovers is never asked about, and the return reads it as missed, a restart)
